title: True To Myself — Vito Fognini & Cari
style: The same recurring protagonist appears in every shot: a woman with dark shoulder-length hair in a long charcoal wool coat. Unified cinematic color grade across the whole film: deep teal shadows, warm amber highlights, lifted blacks, gentle film grain, shot on 65mm anamorphic. Photorealistic.

scenes.still_prompt: a black sand shore at blue hour before a vast ocean of slow-rolling luminous mist; far above, an infinite serene expanse of soft golden-white light breaks through a slate sky, and a single narrow shaft of light descends to the misty horizon. Volumetric haze, contemplative, immense negative space.
beats: Extreme wide shot: the protagonist stands at the water's edge with her back to camera, tiny beneath an immense glowing sky.
Close-up on the protagonist's face in profile, eyes closed, soft mist light playing across her features, hair stirring in the wind.
Overhead aerial shot looking straight down: the protagonist a small dark point on the vast pale shore, luminous mist swirling below.
Medium shot: the protagonist wades ankle-deep into the glowing mist-water, coat hem trailing, ripples of light spreading from her steps.
Wide shot: the shaft of golden light on the horizon has widened into a bright doorway of sky, the protagonist walking along the shore toward it.
scenes.video_prompt: The mist ocean rolls in slow luminous waves while the shaft of golden light on the horizon gently brightens and widens. Her coat stirs in a soft wind.

motion.low: The camera drifts forward almost imperceptibly. Calm, weightless, meditative pacing.
motion.mid: The camera glides forward at walking pace as the light pulses softly with a slow heartbeat rhythm.
motion.high: The camera accelerates low over the mist, streaks of light sweeping past, mist whipping and parting.

scenes.still_prompt: a colossal torchlit stone hall of successive monumental gates receding into darkness, each gate taller than the last, carved with glowing cuneiform and hieroglyphs, a polished obsidian floor reflecting torch flames, embers drifting in the air. Warm firelight against deep indigo shadow, monumental scale.
beats: Wide shot: the protagonist stands dwarfed at the threshold of the first colossal gate, torchlight rimming her silhouette.
Tracking shot in profile: the protagonist walks left to right past carved reliefs, torch flames streaking the blurred foreground.
Extreme close-up: her hand trails along the carved wall as faint glyphs kindle and glow under her fingertips.
Reverse angle from deep in the hall: her small approaching figure framed by a corridor of fire-lit columns.
Low angle from behind her shoulder: the next gate towers open ahead, embers raining slowly through the torchlight.
Detail shot: her boots crossing the polished obsidian floor, reflections of flame rippling away from each step.
scenes.video_prompt: Embers drift and torch flames gutter as she moves deeper down the hall of gates, reflections gliding across the obsidian floor.

motion.low: The camera follows slowly at floor level, solemn processional pacing.
motion.mid: The camera tracks alongside at walking pace, gates sliding past, torchlight strobing gently across the frame.
motion.high: The camera surges forward through gate after gate, flames flaring as each threshold passes, embers streaming past the lens.

scenes.still_prompt: a mountainous night ocean under an apocalyptic electrical storm, colossal waves lit from within by branching lightning; in the sky a vast rotating storm cell glows from inside, a giant humanoid silhouette of light standing wreathed in lightning within its eye; a spur of black rock above the waves. Torrential rain, god-rays through black cloud, VFX blockbuster scale.
beats: Wide shot: the protagonist stands calm on the black rock as a colossal glowing wave rears behind her.
Close-up on her rain-streaked face in profile against the storm, lit for an instant by a lightning flash.
Aerial shot: the rotating storm cell's blazing eye fills the upper frame, her figure minute on the rock far below.
Over-the-shoulder shot from behind her: the giant silhouette of light in the storm's eye, arms slowly opening toward her.
Detail shot: her open hand at her side, rain exploding off her palm, lightning reflected in the wet black rock.
scenes.video_prompt: Colossal waves heave and crash against the rock, spray whipping past her while lightning branches through the rotating storm cell and the giant silhouette of light pulses within its eye.

motion.low: The camera holds a wide static frame, the storm churning in slow majesty.
motion.mid: The camera pushes slowly toward the storm's glowing eye, rain streaking the lens, thunderlight pulsing in rhythm.
motion.high: The camera whips low across the wave tops toward the light, lightning strobing, walls of spray detonating on either side.

scenes.still_prompt: an immense ancient tree rising out of a mist-filled valley at night, trunk wide as a tower, under cold starlight and a rippling green aurora; ember-red glyphs glow in a hollow beneath its roots and sparks of light drift upward along the trunk like slow fireflies. Frost, moonlit bark, deep blues and greens with ember accents, sombre and holy.
beats: Wide shot: the protagonist emerges from the mist at the foot of the world tree, craning her head up at the impossible trunk.
Close-up: her upturned face lit green by the aurora, drifting sparks reflected in her eyes.
Medium shot: she climbs over a huge frost-silvered root, hands on the bark, ember light glowing beneath her.
Overhead shot from within the branches: her figure far below among the roots, sparks spiraling up toward the lens.
Profile close-up: she presses her palm to the glowing red glyphs in the root hollow, their light washing over her coat.
scenes.video_prompt: The aurora ripples overhead while glowing sparks stream slowly up the great trunk and the ember-red glyphs beneath the roots brighten and breathe. Mist coils around the roots.

motion.low: The camera rises very slowly up the trunk toward the canopy and the aurora, weightless and reverent.
motion.mid: The camera circles the tree at a slow orbit, sparks drifting past the lens, aurora light washing the frame in waves.
motion.high: The camera spirals upward fast along the trunk, sparks streaming past like rain, the aurora blazing and rippling violently.

scenes.still_prompt: dawn breaking over an endless plain of translucent crystal spires that refract the sunrise into prismatic beams, a calm golden sun rising through rose and amber sky, a shining avenue running between the spires toward the light. Lens flare, prismatic light scatter, warm hopeful grade, vast and serene.
beats: Wide shot: the protagonist steps out of shadow onto the crystal plain as the first dawn light breaks across it.
Tracking shot from behind: she walks the shining avenue between the spires, her long shadow trailing behind her.
Close-up on her face, seen fully from the front for the first time, calm and resolved, prismatic light drifting across her features.
Aerial shot pulling upward: she walks toward the risen sun down the glittering avenue, the whole plain blazing with refracted light.
scenes.video_prompt: Prismatic beams sweep slowly across the crystal plain as the sun climbs, refractions drifting over her and the avenue of spires glittering.

motion.low: The camera drifts behind her walking figure, slow and resolved, the light growing steadily warmer.
motion.mid: The camera glides past spires alongside her, beams of refracted sunlight strobing gently between them.
motion.high: The camera sweeps up and over the spires into the full blaze of sunrise, prismatic flares streaming across the frame.
